title: Mood / scene
description: Describes in words the scene and the emotion that the music should have, and gives that as style data to blocks that accept it (such as ace-music). It makes no sound itself.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.label: Mood / scene direction
parameters.doc: Describe the setting, energy, instrumentation and emotional arc. Link style to an ACE block to include it in that block's direction.
parameters.placeholder: describe the mood or the scene
